bootstrap.scope: Descriptive, paired per asset; assets are never pooled as independent days.

limitations: Historical bucket-VWAP fills and exogenous participation caps are assumptions. No actual impact, spread, fees, queue access or profit is measured. Prices use only common-complete dates. July-September informed design; October is newly reserved historical validation, not a live trial.

diagnostic_definitions.trigger: Cumulative release exceeds historical release by more than 1e-10 of Q.
diagnostic_definitions.false_alarm: Triggered on a day historical already completes; does not imply a worse price.
diagnostic_definitions.timing_failure: Incomplete despite sufficient full-window capacity; a trigger may have come too late or been too small.
diagnostic_definitions.weighted_participation: Sum(fill * fill / historical_volume) / sum(fill); concentration proxy, not actual cost.
